title: Threshold Check

story.briefing: Power is flowing again, but nothing is watching it. Install a monitor that classifies each reading before a surge reaches the next sector.
story.success: Monitor online. The grid can tell safe from dangerous again.

description: Given an integer power reading, classify it. Return "LOW" if the reading is below 20, "CRITICAL" if it is above 80, and "NOMINAL" for anything in between — including exactly 20 and exactly 80.

examples.explanation: 20 is inclusive, so it is not LOW.

hints: There are three outcomes, so you need to distinguish three ranges.
The boundaries are the risky part. Decide carefully what happens at exactly 20 and exactly 80.
Check "below 20" first, then "above 80", and let everything remaining fall through to NOMINAL. That ordering handles both boundaries for free.
